title: Mouse Intraductal Modeling of Primary Ductal Carcinoma In Situ
author: Hutten, Behbod, et al.
materials: Ensure you have all the equipment necessary for intraductal injections (tissues, razor blades, 70% Ethanol, PBS, 15 mL Falcon tube, 20 μL pipet and tips, 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, anesthesia induction box, waste box, Evans blue (2 mg/mL), syringes, instruments (microscope (EVO CAM II with TV screen), tweezers, Hamilton syringe) and a flow cabinet with isoflurane.

steps.title: Prepare injection equipment
steps.instruction: Gather all materials for intraductal injection: tissues, razor blades, 70 % ethanol, PBS, 15 mL Falcon tube, 20 µL pipette and tips, 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes, anesthesia induction box, waste box, Evans blue (2 mg/mL), syringes, microscope (EVO CAM II with TV screen), tweezers, Hamilton syringe, and a flow cabinet with isoflurane. Timing: 1 day.

steps.title: Label cells with EPCAM antibody
steps.instruction: Label cells from step 52b with 1 µL human‑specific EPCAM‑e660 antibody (1:100), add 90 µL cold FACS buffer, and incubate 20 min on ice protected from light. Optional: repeat this labeling on the 10 µL saved for pre‑sort flow cytometry from step 44.

steps.title: Wash and centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL cold FACS buffer to the labeled cells and centrifuge at 1500 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend cells with DAPI
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant, resuspend the cell pellet in 500 µL cold FACS buffer, and add 5 µL DAPI (1:100).

steps.title: Run flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Perform flow cytometry analysis on the prepared cells, the unstained cells from step 51 (control), and the pre‑sort sample (optional).

steps.title: Calculate cell numbers and volume
steps.instruction: Determine the number of human tumor cells by combining the EPCAM‑positive percentage with the cell count from step 52a. Then calculate the volume of cell suspension needed to obtain 25,000 human cells in 18 µL for intraductal injection into each mammary gland.

steps.title: Freeze cell suspension (optional)
steps.instruction: If the total cell count exceeds 500,000, freeze the single‑cell solution for later use.
